name: Bedroom clock removal

lead: Bedroom clock removal means taking visible clocks and time-displaying devices out of the sleeping area so that waking at night does not lead to checking the time. People adopt it as part of improving sleep, since better sleep is associated with how rested and attractive a person looks.
Sleep hygiene guidance describes a bedroom that is dark, cool and free of devices such as clocks, cell phones or televisions [1].

paras: People turn clock faces away, cover them or move phones out of the bedroom, sometimes using an alarm without a display.
No risks are documented beyond needing another way to wake on time.

chain: No clock to check at night
angle.text: The habit aims at better sleep, which people link to a fresher look. It acts through sleep rather than directly on appearance.

lead: Bedroom clock removal is a sleep habit: clocks are removed or hidden so that nighttime waking does not turn into time-checking. It is one item in sleep hygiene advice, which describes making the bedroom dark, cool and free of devices such as clocks, cell phones or televisions [1].

Within appearance communities, sleep is treated as a way to look more rested, and removing the clock is a low-effort tweak toward that. Related behavioral insomnia approaches emphasize reducing effort and energy spent trying to fall asleep [1].

paras: Sleep hygiene advice lists a bedroom free of clocks, phones and televisions as part of a sleep-friendly environment [1]. Insomnia treatment guidance also suggests leaving bed if sleep does not come within roughly 20 minutes and reducing effort spent trying to sleep [1].
